finding.finding: Current verified evidence reports grid power unavailable at Beruwala (S01) and Padukka (S09), and the Homagama-to-Padukka backhaul link (L09) down. No equipment status is established.

Resolved faults are S01 grid power, S09 grid power, and L09 backhaul. Equipment is verified operational at S01 and S09. Crew C1 and C2 have equipment/generator skills but no listed backhaul skill; no backhaul-skilled crew is supplied. Road closures and site access hazards are not reported. G1 is available at DEPOT, rated true, with 120 minutes and 10 units. Generator deployments take 10 minutes, but generator run duration/load compatibility is not specified. No action is evidenced as unsafe or impossible, so no actions are deferred.

questions.question: Which available crew has the required backhaul skill to perform action BH-L09? Neither listed crew has that skill.
Can G1 supply the required load and duration at S01 or S09, and what are its runtime/fuel constraints? These are not given in the resource information.

finding.finding: Using the approved weights, S09 is critical (weight 5); all other services are standard (weight 1). Current authoritative evidence shows S01 and S09 without grid power, and L09 down. S09 is therefore the highest-priority outage: it is the sole critical-weight service and has both a local power outage and a broken upstream path. S01 also has a confirmed power outage. No credible evidence supports changing any approved service weight.

findings: The cited authoritative snapshots support the plan’s S01 grid-power outage claim and the unmet need for S09 grid-power recovery; battery operation does not establish a separate equipment fault.
V2-07-OBS-03 supports a backhaul outage on L09 (HOM12 to PAD85). The site-directory mapping and extracted facts are consistent.

The Veyangoda complaints, planned future Gampaha interruption, and unconfirmed Padukka-fix rumour do not establish current asset facts; they are appropriately excluded from operational facts and do not make the planned S01 work unsafe on the supplied evidence. The social-media rumour is not authoritative evidence of a completed repair or a reason to defer action, and the plan does not rely on it as such.
